mentions.x: To format a YouTube URL that is indexed to a particular time, just add the minutes/seconds after it like so: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0BaDQCjqUHU#t=24m (or NNs for seconds, or MMmNNs etc.)
I note that format doesn't work with Invidious, it only handles the older(?) format using & instead of # : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0BaDQCjqUHU&t=24m
